issues.desc: All 3 checklist items are missing the required userSees field. Per CLAUDE.md userSees is mandatory and must contain precise observable output text, not abstract descriptions. Without it reviewers cannot confirm what the developer will actually see after each item is done.

Background reads as an engineering post-mortem rather than a user-value statement. The concrete symptom — developer runs a gate command and gets told to execute a wrapper file that does not exist — should be stated explicitly rather than implied.

CHK-002 relatedDocs includes session-ownership-and-write-leases.md but the item is about guidance text for CLI entrypoints — the connection is non-obvious and may confuse implementers. Consider replacing with a more directly relevant doc or adding a comment explaining the link.
